orientation.front: +Z (logo face; viewer camera should sit at +Z looking toward -Z)

design: Two separate basalt monoliths. Stone is the space around the Hyperiux logo: the four filled SVG paths and the cube's hexagon are cut through; a 0.45 m gap runs from the top edge and from the ground into the hexagon, splitting the slab into left/right halves. Cut walls are deliberately roughened (not laser-perfect).

root.name: MonolithRoot
root.transform: identity at world origin (base centre of the whole monument, ground plane y=0)

HyperiuxMonolith_Left.pivotNote: base-centre of the piece, on the ground (y=0)

HyperiuxMonolith_Right.pivotNote: base-centre of the piece, on the ground (y=0)

svgMapping.cutRoughness_m: outline wobble up to ~0.06 m, varying through depth, plus chipped bites along front/back edges

splitGap.note: channels follow the hexagon apex (top) and bottom vertex; walls roughened ±0.05 m

cube.note: Add the cube in React Three Fiber.
cube.positionSource: centre of the cube-outline hexagon path in the SVG (rounded top apex reconstructed)
cube.rightOffsetNote: configurable; add to position.x if the art direction wants the cube nudged right
cube.recommendedEdgeNote: keeps clearance from the roughened opening walls at mid-depth
cube.isometricRotationThree: rotation={[Math.atan(1 / Math.SQRT2), Math.PI / 4, 0]} (corner toward the camera, matches the logo drawing)

material.name: HyperiuxBasalt
material.r3fTips: Raise material.emissiveIntensity (e.g. 2-4) with Bloom for glowing fissures; the cut openings are plain stone, light them from behind in R3F.

validation.holes: none (a few zero-width boolean seams, not visible)
